blocks.text: Walnut Grove Homes for Sale: Houses and Townhomes

parts.t: Walnut Grove is a residential neighbourhood in northwest Langley, in the Township of Langley. It has been planned since 1979, so most homes for sale are established detached houses and townhomes, with some condos. The Golden Ears Bridge connects it to communities north of the Fraser River.

The Walnut Grove sales table above uses MLS® sub-area F61 only. Detached homes sold in the last 12 months had a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 5,882 sq ft. Townhomes sell here often, so there are good recent sales to compare.

blocks.text: Parts of Walnut Grove to know

parts.t: The Walnut Grove Community Plan (Bylaw No. 1836) covers seven residential neighbourhoods and one community service neighbourhood. It is now Schedule 6 to the Township's 2025 OCP Update.
The Redwoods Neighbourhood Plan, adopted May 26, 1997, covers about 69.3 hectares around 216 Street, the eastern-most part of Walnut Grove.
The Walnut Grove Community Centre at 8889 Walnut Grove Drive has a 50 m pool, fitness centre, gym and a library branch. Walnut Grove Community Park is next to it at 89 Avenue.
The plan sets aside open space along natural watercourses and ravines. Homes backing onto them can have streamside setbacks.
Walnut Grove Secondary (grades 8 to 12) and six K to 7 elementary schools: Alex Hope, Dorothy Peacock, Gordon Greenwood, James Kennedy, Topham and West Langley.

blocks.text: More Walnut Grove searches and tools

parts.t: What kinds of homes are for sale in Walnut Grove?
Mostly established detached houses and townhomes, with some condos. The sales table on this page shows the Walnut Grove sub-area only.
How old are homes in Walnut Grove?
The community plan was adopted in 1979 and the last neighbourhood plan, Redwoods, in 1997. Detached homes sold in the last 12 months had a median year built of 1990.
What is at the Walnut Grove Community Centre?
A 50 m pool with a waterslide, diving boards and a leisure pool, plus a fitness centre, gymnasium, preschool and a library branch, at 8889 Walnut Grove Drive.
Is there transit in Walnut Grove?
Yes. TransLink routes include the 562 (Langley Centre/Walnut Grove) and the 509 (Walnut Grove/Surrey Central Station).
